description: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka - Notify the Checklist of Implementing Standards for the information of the aviation personnel
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of a checklist of implementing standards under the Civil Aviation Act No. 14 of 2010. It constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements for aviation operations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. The document is issued by the Director General of Civil Aviation using powers vested by the Civil Aviation Act, making it a statutory instrument rather than a government personnel or organizational matter.
